subject.title: fix(backup): sweep stale temp artifacts before creating new backup

question: Should backup startup automatically delete stale OpenClaw-owned backup temp artifacts after the guarded grace window?
rationale: The code defect is mechanical, but the cleanup policy intentionally makes older matching temp artifacts disposable and needs maintainer acceptance before merge.

options.title: Accept guarded startup cleanup
options.body: Land this direction after the timestamped-output matcher, branch conflict, and proof gap are fixed.

options.title: Limit to manual cleanup
options.body: Avoid automatic deletion and instead route cleanup through docs, operator guidance, or a doctor command.

options.title: Accept fixed-basename cleanup only
options.body: Accept partial cleanup for stable output filenames and leave timestamped defaults to follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded startup cleanup
recommendation.body: Land this direction after the timestamped-output matcher, branch conflict, and proof gap are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to both original backup CLI merge context and the infra extraction that owns the current implementation surface.
